## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX in CORRECTION (1W: -3.01% | 1M: +9.12%) showing fear easing and SPY in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) with Stocks vs Bonds rising confirm the risk tilt.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress flagged higher: HYG in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) and LQD in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) but HYG_LQD noted as CREDIT STRESS ↑ — watch credit friction. Energy/oil strength (XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%); BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%)) is a pro-cyclicality tailwind.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: UUP in RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) showing a firmer dollar short-term while TLT in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) keeps duration supported and Stocks vs Bonds rising signals equity preference.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) showing strength; XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) indicates tech momentum is short-term bounce not broad confirmation — style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US and EM both strong: SPY in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and EEM in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) outperforming several developed pockets; Japan (EWJ in CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%)) is mixed.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation showing selective appetite: IWM in RECOVERY (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%), ARKK in RECOVERY (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) and IBIT in RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) signal risk-on positioning but with short-term dispersion.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity reflation: CPER in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%), GLD in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) and SLV in RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) show commodity upside alongside industrial strength.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) driving cyclicals, while natural gas UNG in BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (9/11) plus VXX falling and Stocks vs Bonds rising support RISK-ON. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — multiple core ETFs (XLK, QQQ, IWM) are in RECOVERY (1W positive, 1M negative) which mutes conviction and warrants selectivity.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodity-linked exposures (XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), TAN in ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%)); reduce exposure to long-duration, speculative tech exposure (XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%), QQQ in RECOVERY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -1.21%)) and monitor credit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%); Industrials — XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%). BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG in BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%); Watch tech if XLK fails to convert RECOVERY into ABOVE TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil/Brent — BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%); Copper — CPER in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%). BEARISH: Silver volatility to watch — SLV in RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) and nat gas UNG in BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health trigger), XLK/ XLF spread (monitor relative performance pivot), SPY near short-term support defined by recent pullback lows around current 1M range.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, confirmed by VXX falling and Stocks vs Bonds rising. Energy, materials and cyclicals showing relative strength while tech is a short-term RECOVERY. Key risk: MAJOR divergence as multiple core ETFs sit in RECOVERY (1W positive, 1M negative) and credit metrics signal rising stress — monitor HYG/LQD and tech resilience.
